title: Hypre hybrid solver parameters
description: Public parameter-list controls for the shared HYPRE hybrid linear solver. The same object is used for the momentum-solver and projection-solver settings. The 2D flow solvers use CG; additional backend parameters are permitted so that less commonly used AMG controls can pass through even when they are not documented here.

rel-tol.description: Required relative convergence tolerance for the Krylov solve. The solve is considered converged when its relative residual meets this tolerance, subject to the other convergence controls.

abs-tol.description: Absolute convergence tolerance for the Krylov solve. The default is zero, so no nonzero absolute tolerance is supplied.

conv-rate-tol.description: Optional convergence-rate tolerance. It must be strictly between zero and one.

max-ds-iter.description: Required maximum number of diagonally scaled Krylov iterations.

max-amg-iter.description: Required maximum number of AMG-preconditioned Krylov iterations.

cg-use-two-norm.description: Whether CG convergence uses the two-norm criterion. This control is considered only when krylov-method is cg.

logging-level.description: HYPRE logging level. Zero disables solver logging; larger values enable progressively more diagnostic output. The default is 1.

print-level.description: HYPRE print level. Zero suppresses solver print output; larger values request more output. The default is 0.

amg-strong-threshold.description: Strength threshold used by the AMG coarsening algorithm. It must be strictly between zero and one; the default is 0.5.

amg-max-levels.description: Optional maximum number of AMG levels. It must be greater than one.

amg-smoothing-sweeps.description: Number of AMG smoothing sweeps. The default is one sweep.

amg-smoothing-method.description: AMG relaxation or smoothing method selector passed to HYPRE.

amg-interp-method.description: AMG interpolation method selector passed to HYPRE.
